dimensions.assessment: Affects children, adolescents, young adults, parents, health care agencies, hospitals, and tribal organizations eligible for grant funding.
dimensions.evidence: prevent suicide or overdose by children, adolescents, and young adults

dimensions.assessment: Enables eligible entities to provide parental counseling and furnish supplies to prevent the misuse of lethal means for suicide and overdose.
dimensions.evidence: furnishing supplies to parents or legal guardians to prevent the misuse of lethal means commonly used in overdose or suicide.

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorizations through fiscal year 2030 and specifies a minimum allocation of $2,000,000 for specific grant categories annually.
dimensions.evidence: not less than $2,000,000 shall be allocated to awarding grants pursuant to subparagraphs (A), (B), and (C) of paragraph (4).

dimensions.assessment: Amends the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act to broaden eligible entity types and add suicide prevention activities.
dimensions.evidence: Section 7102(c) of the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act (42 U.S.C. 290bb-7a(c)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends the authorization of appropriations for the grant program through fiscal year 2030.
dimensions.evidence: by striking '2019 through 2023' and inserting '2026 through 2030'

missing_information: Total overall authorized appropriation cap for the grant program for fiscal years 2026 through 2030
importance_detail.rationale: Expands allowable uses for existing substance abuse grants under the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act to include youth suicide and overdose prevention, and extends grant authorizations through 2030.
